summary.business_type: SaaS / free online craft tool (photo-to-dice-art generator), B2C, English, no local footprint
top_findings: Terms contradict pricing (Creator Pass 'permanent' vs 30 days; Explorer project limit vs 'unlimited'); Privacy Policy names Vercel Analytics, omits PostHog session replay, Cloudflare, Supabase

Organic sessions down ~80% May→Sep 2026 (1,886→343); clicks halved the week of the May 21 2026 Core Update; two exact-match tool competitors (diceartgenerator.io/.com, registered 22–23 Jan 2026, upload box in hero) now hold the desktop 'generator' SERP; desktop position swings 3 ↔ 20–46
No visible person/entity: no About page, Article author = Organization, no sameAs/founder/Wikidata; the only third-party description is a competitor rating Diceify 3/5
/gallery is 57 words with 0.35% CTR at position 9 and 6.1 s mobile LCP (lazy LCP image, 13 × 150 KB single-size images)
'Built by hand' copy and schema sit on digital renders; no real build photos in main content
quick_wins: priority on the first four gallery cards (LCP 6.1 s → ~2.5 s)
Cache rules in public/_headers (immutable _next/static, 30 d images)
Fix Terms §4.1/4.4/5.1 and the Privacy processor list
Organization sameAs + founder + a visible 'Diceify is…' sentence; point 'dice art generator' anchors at / not /editor
Bing Webmaster verification + Cloudflare Crawler Hints (IndexNow); prefetch={false} on /editor links; drop-trailing-slash (307→301)

what_works: Self-canonical flat URLs

findings.title: No long-lived caching on hashed assets or images
findings.description: cache-control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate on /_next/static/* and /images/*; ~50 conditional requests per repeat view
findings.recommendation: Add cache blocks to public/_headers: _next/static immutable 1 y; images 30 d + stale-while-revalidate

findings.title: Gallery LCP 6.1 s on mobile
findings.description: LCP element is a lazy-loaded next/image fill card; no srcset
findings.recommendation: priority on first row; responsive variants

findings.title: Homepage canonical slash inconsistency
findings.description: canonical/og:url/hreflang/sitemap use https://diceify.art; Google canonical is https://diceify.art/
findings.recommendation: Emit the slash form for the home path in lib/seo.ts and app/sitemap.ts

findings.title: /account indexable while disallowed
findings.description: 200, index,follow, same title/description as /editor; robots.txt Disallow hides any noindex
findings.recommendation: Remove Disallow, add noindex metadata and a distinct title

findings.title: No HSTS, no CSP
findings.description: Headers absent on all responses
findings.recommendation: Strict-Transport-Security max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; CSP as Report-Only first

findings.title: 307 temporary redirects for slash/.html variants
findings.description: /dice-art/, /gallery/, /index.html, /dice-art.html → 307 via html_handling auto-trailing-slash
findings.recommendation: wrangler.jsonc html_handling: drop-trailing-slash; re-test /s/*

findings.title: /blog/why-i-built-diceify never indexed
findings.description: GSC: Discovered – currently not indexed; 2 internal links, no images, dated 2024
findings.recommendation: Add links, images, real update; then Request Indexing

findings.title: /editor is a client-rendered shell
findings.description: 66 words of HTML text ('Loading workspace…'), position 28, same metadata as /account
findings.recommendation: Static 100–150-word intro + noscript

findings.title: Minor hygiene
findings.description: Two robots metas on the 404; no security.txt; manifest crossorigin=use-credentials; no IndexNow
findings.recommendation: Dedupe, add security.txt, enable Cloudflare Crawler Hints

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: /dice-art: answer-first guide, Flesch ~81, correct size math (363 dice/ft² at 16 mm), both glue methods with a real failure story, genuine Last updated
Two first-hand stories with specifics (founder's COVID build with video; Jeremy's plywood/Liquid Nails build)
No filler or AI-pattern phrasing; non-templated metadata
Concrete worked example on the homepage (87×77 · 4,564 black · 2,135 white)

findings.title: Terms contradict pricing
findings.description: §4.4 'permanent access … for the lifetime of the Service' vs 30-day Creator Pass (plans.ts accessDays 30); §4.1 project limit vs 'unlimited projects'
findings.recommendation: Rewrite §4.1, §4.4, §5.1; bump Last updated

findings.title: Privacy Policy out of date
findings.description: Names Vercel Analytics (unused); omits PostHog session replay, Cloudflare, Supabase; dated Jan 2025
findings.recommendation: List real processors, replay masking, retention, legal entity

findings.title: Renders presented as hand-built pieces
findings.description: 'built by hand' on /gallery, /dice-art and ImageGallery schema; images are digital renders; only real build photo is a blog thumbnail
findings.recommendation: Correct copy; add a Real builds section; label Built / Digital preview

findings.title: No About page, author bio, founder or sameAs
findings.description: Founder appears only as a byline; /dice-art author is the Organization
findings.recommendation: /about page, Person schema, Person as guide author, Organization founder + sameAs

findings.title: /gallery thin (57 words), CTR 0.35% at position 9.3
findings.description: Name-only captions; description promises 'loved ones' not on the page; grid sizes only in filenames
findings.recommendation: Data captions (grid, dice count, size), intro, sections, new title/description

findings.title: Blog stale and partly unindexed
findings.description: 2 posts (2023-11, 2024-01), no dates on cards, no body images, founder post not indexed, video without VideoObject
findings.recommendation: 1–2 first-hand posts/month, dates, media, VideoObject

findings.title: Unanswered questions AI engines take elsewhere
findings.description: Weight, bulk cost, framing/hanging, exports (no PDF), templates, comparison are missing
findings.recommendation: Measured first-party numbers in /dice-art; templates and comparison pages

findings.title: Factual and byline errors in the Jeremy post
findings.description: '35 × 47 inches' is the dice grid (frame 26×32 in); byline credits Jeremy for a third-person rewrite
findings.recommendation: Fix the sentence; correct the byline or get a first-person Q&A

findings.title: Build-time figures disagree across pages
findings.description: 'a day or two' vs 'a full day' vs '100+ hours' for ~1,600 dice
findings.recommendation: One source of truth; publish a measured dice/hour rate

findings.title: Unsubstantiated and stale claims
findings.description: 'Join 5,000+ creators' unsourced; footer © 2025, schema © 2024
findings.recommendation: Tie to real data or soften; build-time year
